text: Hello, boys and girls, I am Miss Tan.Nice to meet you again.Today we will go on learning Module 4, Unit 3, Story Time.As we know, Eddy and his friends act out the story together.What story is it?Yes, it's a boy and a wolf.They act as different roles.他们分别扮演了谁呢?Can you try to say?Good try.Whom do they act as?Let's listen and read.Good.The children start to act.Children, shall we be the boy and review the story?Let's go.Here come the farmers.Where's the wolf?Ha ha, no wolves.A wolf, help, help.You are a bad boy.Here comes the wolf.Oh no, help, help.A poor boy.Nice reading.As we know, the boy cries the wolf again and again.But no wolves.The boy plays tricks on the farmers and laughs.Finally, when the wolf really comes, the boy cries out in fear.那么,在听到小男孩的叫声后,萌孵又是怎么做的呢?What do the farmers do at first?Do they come to help?Let's watch.Do the farmers come?Yes, they do.So, the narrator says,Here come the farmers.What does she say?She says,Here come the farmers.Read after me.Here, here, come, come.Let's be the narrator.The farmers come and ask the boy a question.Listen.They ask,Where's the wolf?Where, where, where's, where's.Let's follow the farmers to ask.What does the boy say?Could you be the boy?Oh, no wolves.The farmers are angry.Okay, let's follow the children to read.Here we go.At first, the farmers come to help.The boy tells a lie.What about the second time?What about the third time?What about the fourth time?Let's go on watching.What do the narrator, the farmers and the boy say?Please think and say.What do they say?Let's listen.They say,You are a bad boy.Listen again.Children, is it good or bad to tell a lie?Of course it's bad.So the farmers think the boy is a bad boy.A bad boy.The farmers are so angry.Can you be the farmers?Super.OK, let's read in rows.Girls, you will be the narrator.Boys, you will be the farmer.And I will be the boy.So this time the farmers come to help again.The boy tells a lie again.At the third time, do they come to help?Let's have a look.Oh, the wolf comes.Listen to the narrator.Follow me.Coms.The wolf comes.The boy cries out in fear.小男孩叫了这么久,农夫还没有出现。Oh, the farmers don't believe the boy.The wolf catches the boy.Poor, poor.Children, can we tell a lie?So, the narrator tells us.Don't tell a lie.小朋友们,这句话是什么意思呢?不要说谎。Bingo.Tell a lie.Boys and girls, let's follow the children to read.At last, do the farmers come?The wolf runs away.Yes or no?And the farmers drive the wolf away.Run away.Pay attention.Children, can you read by yourselves?Please have a try.If you are a boy, what would you say to the farmers?What do they say to each other?I'm sorry.小男孩知错能改。Good boy.Children, would you like to enjoy the whole story?Where is the wolf?A wolf.Help.Ha ha.No wolves.Oh no.这个故事告诉我们什么道理呢?That's right.小朋友们,课后如果你感兴趣的话,可以像Eddie他们一样,约上你的小伙伴一起演一遍故事哦。That's all for today.Dear children, you did good jobs.Bye bye.
